name: data-row
title: DataRow
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A ledger line: dot, name, mono meta, figure and running total. Use for any list of transactions or entries.

hairline.example: <DataRow dot="var(--a-coral)" name="School fees" meta="22 Mar · Mobile money" state="alarm" amount="−258 900" secondary="227 400" />
hairline.antiExampleWhy: Unformatted figure, no tabular alignment, and a table border model the system does not use.

docs: A settled or skipped line uses `state="demoted"` or `"struck"` — it steps down AND takes a mark, because lightness alone is not readable.
